'''Psilocybin''' was a psychedelic compound. A hybrid version of psilocybin was produced by the spores of the [[Amanita Lumikurnizi]], a plant found in the jungle caverns of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], and the compound acted as a powerful mental and physical stimulant for most organic life-forms&mdash;though only temporarily, and large doses were highly toxic.
